text:
anya_product: Quick async sync — pricing/packaging rollout: metering adapter + quota enforcement changes. In particular we need to confirm owners for metering adapter PR, billing schema migration, and contract gating flag. Are we green to run canary in staging tomorrow?

sam_eng: I'm owner for the metering adapter PR #4821, I can do staging canary. Need DB migration window for billing events (schema v2). @joseph_billing do we have migration script?

joseph_billing: I have migration ready but need contract team sign-off for retro pricing clause. If clause present we must not touch historical invoices. That means migration must only start from cutoff date. Link to contract note: https://redwood.example.com/contracts/retro-pricing

maya_sre: :eyes: Also need quota enforcement behavior documented — do we enforce strict or soft for early rollout? If strict, SLOs might be impacted.

irene_security: Security/PII ok with events schema, but need KMS key rotation window noted. Add me to runbook.

anya_product: agreed. Proposal: canary in staging with soft-quota, no retro migrations. Full migration gated on legal ok + billing smoke-green. Timeline: staging canary tomorrow 06:00-08:00 PT, prod canary next Tue. Thoughts?

sam_eng: Sounds good. I'll open a canary runbook and tag infra. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/meters/pull/4821

joseph_billing: I'll prep migration script with cutoff param. We should also add a feature flag `pricing.v2.migration_cutoff` and ensure meter events before cutoff are processed by legacy pipeline. Example config:

```
pricing:
  v2:
    enabled: true
    migration_cutoff: "2026-03-18T00:00:00Z"
```

maya_sre: Smoke tests we need:
- end-to-end billing run for a small customer (100 requests)
- quota throttle behavior: send burst to ensure soft enforcement works
- logs/trace tags: pricing=v2, canary=true

anya_product: Assign owners:
- metering adapter PR/rollout: @sam_eng
- billing migration script + vet: @joseph_billing
- runbook + SRE checks: @maya_sre
- contract gating + legal sign-off: @hannah_contracts

hannah_contracts: I'll review the clause today. If there's any retro-charge wording we'll block migration. ETA 24h.

maya_sre: I'll schedule the canary window and add smoke tests to runbook. ping me once PR merged.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: staging cluster - rollout id r-20260317-9, window 2026-03-17T06:00Z -> 2026-03-17T08:00Z. Tags: pricing-v2, canary. :robot_face:

sam_eng: Thanks all. Will merge PR after minor lint fix. I'll post status here once deployed. :thumbsup:
